hints.title: Key Insight and Observation
hints.text: Identify the earliest occurrence of a zero from the left and the latest non-zero from the right.

hints.title: Algorithmic Strategy and State
hints.text: Swap these two elements whenever the left pointer is strictly before the right pointer.

hints.title: Optimal Boundary and Processing
hints.text: Advance pointers inwards until they cross, counting the minimum total swaps.

hints.title: Complete Implementation
hints.text:
```python
def minSwaps(nums: list[int]) -> int:
    arr = nums[:]
    i = 0
    j = len(arr) - 1
    swaps = 0
    while i < j:
        while i < j and arr[i] != 0:
            i += 1
        while i < j and arr[j] == 0:
            j -= 1
        if i < j:
            arr[i], arr[j] = arr[j], arr[i]
            swaps += 1
            i += 1
            j -= 1
    return swaps
```

complexity.notes: Opposite two pointer traversal swaps out of place zeros directly in linear time.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Bubble sort or simulated adjacent shifts require O(n^2) operations.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Operates with constant auxiliary pointer variables.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Applies two pointers opposite strategy to greedily minimize swaps.
